selected_passages.title: sources/SBF_s_trial_starts_soon_but_how_did_he_and_FTX_get_here
selected_passages.text:
- The trial started on a Tuesday.
- Bankman-Fried is 31 years old.
- FTX was co-founded in 2019.
- Alameda Research was co-founded in 2017.
- FTX's peak valuation was $32 billion.
- Over 80 investors provided $2 billion in capital to FTX.
- FTX raised $400 million in a Series C round in January 2022.
- FTX bought the naming rights for the Miami Heat's arena in 2021.
- Tom Brady and Gisele Bündchen were FTX brand partners.
- Steph Curry, Shaquille O'Neal, and Naomi Osaka were FTX partners.
- CoinDesk published Alameda's balance sheet in early November 2022.
- Alameda held $14.6 billion in assets and $8 billion in liabilities as of June 30, 2022.
- Alameda owned $5.82 billion in FTT tokens, exceeding the total market cap.
- Binance pulled out $2.1 billion in cash in BUSD and FTT.
- FTX and Alameda filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in mid-November 2022.
- John J. Ray III was appointed FTX's new CEO.
- Bankman-Fried was arrested in the Bahamas in December 2022.
- Bankman-Fried was released on a $250 million bail bond.
- Bankman-Fried was accused of intimidating Caroline Ellison in August.
- Gary Wang and Caroline Ellison pleaded guilty in December 2022.
- BlockFi filed for Chapter 11 in November 2022.
- Genesis Global Trading filed for Chapter 11 in January.
- Mark Cohen represented Bankman-Fried in the trial.
- Mark Cohen previously represented Ghislaine Maxwell.

selected_passages.text:
- Sam Bankman-Fried was the former CEO of FTX.
- The trial took place on the second day.
- Thane Rehn was the prosecutor for the government.
- Mark Cohen was one of Bankman-Fried's lawyers.
- Damian Williams is the U.S. attorney for the Southern District of New York.
- Caroline Ellison was the CEO of Alameda Research.
- Alameda Research is a crypto hedge fund owned by Bankman-Fried.
- Jane Street is a high-frequency trading firm where Bankman-Fried started.
- Matt Huang is a former partner at Sequoia Capital.
- Marc-Antoine Julliard is a Paris-born cocoa trader living in London.
- Julliard invested in Bitcoin and Dogecoin on FTX.
- Julliard tried to withdraw almost $100,000 on November 8.
- Adam Yedidia is a graduate of MIT.
- Yedidia was a close friend of Bankman-Fried in college.
- Yedidia worked as a trader at Alameda and a developer at FTX.
- Yedidia has legal immunity during his testimony.
- Bankman-Fried spent about seven weeks in a Brooklyn prison.
- The prosecution's story lasted roughly 30 minutes.
- Tom Brady and Larry David are celebrities mentioned in the prosecution's account.
- Fortune magazine is cited as having written about Bankman-Fried as a 'crypto boy' genius.

- Bankman-Fried spent seven weeks in a Brooklyn prison before this trial, resulting in more prominent cheekbones.
